lamby._doc: ⚑ S392 (UiB job 26 B0; G2, his 15 Oct: "reinstate Lamby as the connection point of the correction and forcing you to do stuff") — `call`: Lamby, in the era's skin, says where the TV is and that it will take the visitor there; Take me there turns them at once, and if the visitor closes the balloon (logged, like every dismissal) the piece still turns them when the call's time is up: it is the programme's assignment, and Lamby is its voice.
